premise: Leo's long-awaited parcel arrives in the supply pod: a small telescope, and his very first look through it is at a faraway galaxy whose light set off millions of years ago.
inspiration: The traveller's long road home of the old tales (the Odyssey), turned: the long-travelled one is a beam of light, and it arrives at a telescope.
lesson: Some things are worth the wait.
learning: Light from a faraway galaxy takes millions of years to reach us, so we see it as it was long ago.

en-US.title: First Light
en-US.text: {man:enter} Leo had waited months for this parcel. {man:face happy} {sfx:thud} Thump! Down onto the landing pad came the {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} supply pod. {supply-pod:live hold} Its side panels slid open, and there, in a crate marked LEO, was a small telescope. {man:hop x2} {canvas:nightfall} He waited for the long Moon night. Then he pointed it up, past the ridge, at a faint smudge of light. [short pause] {man:face surprised} [gasps] It was a {galaxy:enter} {galaxy:float loop 0.2} galaxy! A soft swirl of more stars than anyone could ever count. {galaxy:live hold} It glowed in the dark, so still, so far away. {man:live} Leo checked his wrist. That light had been travelling for millions of years, since long before there were any people at all. {man:says} [in awe] “You've come such a long way. Hello.” {supply-pod:live resume} The supply pod closed its panels, its job done. {man:face happy} {man:hearts} {man:says} [warmly] “Best parcel ever.”

es-ES.title: Primera luz
es-ES.text: {man:enter} Leo llevaba meses esperando este paquete. {man:face happy} {sfx:thud} ¡Pum! Sobre la plataforma de aterrizaje bajó la {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} cápsula de carga. {supply-pod:live hold} Sus paneles se abrieron y allí, en una caja que decía LEO, había un pequeño telescopio. {man:hop x2} {canvas:nightfall} Esperó a la larga noche lunar. Luego lo apuntó hacia arriba, por encima de las montañas, a una manchita de luz. [short pause] {man:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Era una {galaxy:enter} {galaxy:float loop 0.2} galaxia! Un remolino suave de más estrellas de las que nadie podría contar. {galaxy:live hold} Brillaba en la oscuridad, tan quieta, tan lejana. {man:live} Leo miró su muñeca. Esa luz llevaba millones de años viajando, desde mucho antes de que hubiera personas. {man:says} [in awe] «Has venido desde muy lejos. Hola.» {supply-pod:live resume} La cápsula de carga cerró sus paneles, con el trabajo hecho. {man:face happy} {man:hearts} {man:says} [warmly] «El mejor paquete del mundo.»
